title: Recipe 56 — The self-improvement flywheel (run → rate → distill → optimize)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Four verbs, one loop: run it, rate it, distill the ratings into a dataset, optimize against that dataset.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — nothing committed is touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env — every turn of the flywheel is billed model calls.

groups.title: Beat 1 · Step 1 — declare that you want feedback

beats.label: Type the recipe's spec
beats.cue: “Twelve lines. The only unusual thing is that it opts into rating collection — the rest is an ordinary agent.”

beats.label: Lint it
beats.cue: “Clean. Feedback capture is a declared feature, not a wrapper you install.”

beats.label: Compile it and check it
beats.cue: “--check: GREEN, gated at the model credential.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok; install ok; boot gated at the provider credentials gate

groups.title: Beat 2 · the verbs, before you run them

beats.label: Read the distill contract
beats.cue: “Step 3: distill turns rated turns into a registered dataset with a deterministic split — same input, same split, every time.”

beats.label: Open it
beats.cue: “--register names the dataset. That name is what optimize will ask for later.”

beats.label: List the registry
beats.cue: “Empty, on a fresh machine — which is the honest starting state of every flywheel.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “You can't optimize against a dataset you haven't earned. Step 2 is where you earn it.”

beats.label: Run the agent
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Step 2 starts by having a session worth rating.”

verify.note: interactive REPL; needs a model credential

beats.label: Ask it something you can judge
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Pick a question where you'll know a bad answer when you see one.”
beats.text: A customer wants a refund 40 days after purchase. What do I tell them?

beats.label: Rate the turn
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Thumbs, stars, or a written note. The note is worth more than the stars.”

verify.note: needs a real session id from the run above

beats.label: Distill the ratings
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Step 3: every rated session becomes one registered, versioned dataset.”

verify.note: the --judge pass is billed model calls

beats.label: Turn the flywheel
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Step 4: compile gate → baseline eval → optimize → post eval. It refuses to promote a regression.”

verify.note: the full loop; billed on both the candidate and the judge

groups.title: One more thing · rehearse it first

beats.label: Read the flywheel contract
beats.cue: “There is a rehearsal mode. Use it before you point this at a spec you care about.”
beats.command: crewhaus flywheel run --help > live/flywheel.txt 2>&1; test -s live/flywheel.txt

verify.note: the shipped flywheel run flags, including the dry-run form

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “Rehearse without touching anything — then look at what it would have changed.”

beats.label: Wire it into CI
beats.cue: [manual] “flywheel init writes a GitHub Actions workflow into your repo — a human reviews that before it lands.”

verify.note: writes .github/workflows/; review the generated workflow before committing
